summary: All 23 requirements implemented in 9 files under sranger/; single controller SRangerController with modes MOVING, TURNING, FINAL and 7 transitions (one per SR-Beh requirement, SR-DC1). Ten decisions the requirements did not settle are listed below.

issues.title: Large default distance when no IR reading is available: 100.0 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 asks for 'a large default value' when no reading is available, without a number.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor.NO_READING_DISTANCE = 100.0 m (200x obstacleThreshold, beyond any IR range). Replace it if the platform specifies a value.

issues.title: Negative or NaN IR measurements are treated as no reading
issues.raw: SR-DM5/SR-SF1 say distance() is non-negative but not what to do with an invalid measurement.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor.update stores the reading only if reading >= 0.0; otherwise it stores the no-reading default, so invalid data never triggers obstacle detection (consistent with SR-DM5's intent).

issues.title: Moving -> Turning: obstacle event and obstacleDetected guard combined
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 names the obstacle event as the trigger; SR-GP1 names obstacleDetected (distance <= obstacleThreshold) as the guard of the same transition.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented as trigger obstacle with condition obstacleDetected; an obstacle event whose distance reading is above the threshold is ignored.

issues.title: Order of the clock reset and Move(0, turnVel) on entering Turning
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 lists 'set clockResetTime ... and issue Move(0, turnVel)'; SR-FR2 lists the Move first.
issues.fix_directive: clockResetTime is set first, then Move(0, turnVel) is issued (SR-Beh2 order, the transition requirement).

issues.title: Turning: priority endTask > turnDurationElapsed > tick
issues.raw: All requirements have priority 1; the Turning transitions SR-Beh5/6/7 can be enabled together.
issues.fix_directive: endTask (operator shutdown) first; the autonomous return to Moving before the tick self-loop, which conjoins !turnDurationElapsed (rules 4b), so a tick every cycle cannot hold the robot in Turning.

issues.title: Initial Move(moveVel, 0) is issued by the constructor
issues.raw: SR-FR1/SR-Beh1: the controller starts in Moving and entering Moving issues Move(moveVel, 0).
issues.fix_directive: The constructor issues the power-up Move; step() issues it on Turning -> Moving. The extracted initial transition may not carry this action.

issues.title: obstacleThreshold = 0.5 is rounded up to 1 in the model's constants
issues.raw: Rules 2: the constants interface rounds a fractional constant up to the next integer.
issues.fix_directive: The Java guard uses 0.5 exactly; in the model obstacleDetected reads distance() <= 1. The other constants (1.0, 2.0, 2.0) are integral.

issues.title: Move carries two real record components
issues.raw: SR-DM4: one output event Move carrying a linear and an angular velocity.
issues.fix_directive: OutputEvent.Move(double lv, double av), issued via actuator.apply(new OutputEvent.Move(...)); no wrapper datatype.

issues.title: Time source is a Clock class held in a field named timer
issues.raw: SR-Var1/SR-GP2 need the current time; 'clock' is a RoboChart reserved word.
issues.fix_directive: sranger.sensor.Clock (now(), advance(seconds)); turnDurationElapsed = timer.now() - clockResetTime >= TURN_DURATION, i.e. since(clockResetTime) >= TURN_DURATION.

issues.title: Actuator's last command before power-up is Move(0, 0)
issues.raw: SR-DM6 does not say what the actuator holds before the first command.
issues.fix_directive: Initialised to a stop, Move(0, 0); the controller's constructor overwrites it immediately.

next_step: Run the pipeline; revisit the flagged choices if a verifier or the vacuity audit points at them.
